> "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"settings page instead — see API Key management."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"1. **Workspaces** — create, update, delete and list workspaces and their sessions.

3. **Model"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s & settings** — list models and providers, read and update the global default model, read
settings "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"namespaces, list agent presets.
4. **Streaming** — `POST /sessions/:id/prompt-stream` pushes `delta`"},{"id":"p26s5","text":", `reasoning`, `tool_call`,
`tool_result` and `turn_end` over Server-Sent Events; `GET /sessions/:id"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"/events` taps the session's
raw event bus.
**Streaming & timeout semantics (important)**: all three "},{"id":"p26s7","text":"chat entry points (`prompt` /
`prompt-stream` / `chat/completions`) use a **stall watchdog** instead"},{"id":"p26s8","text":" of a wall-clock turn limit —
continuously producing turns (long text generation, multi-step tool ru"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ns) are never cut off no
matter how long they take; only a sustained absence of session events abort"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"s with an explicit
error. Tune via `timeoutMs` (sync entry point, stall gap, default 180s) and `stal"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"lTimeoutMs`
(streaming entry point, default 300s). Every SSE channel emits a `': ping'` comment fram"},{"id":"p26s12","text":"e every
15s as a heartbeat so middle proxies/gateways cannot drop idle streams; any internal stream "},{"id":"p26s13","text":"error
surfaces as a visible `error` event instead of a silent disconnect.
5. **OpenAI compatibility*"},{"id":"p26s14","text":"* — `POST /chat/completions` accepts a standard OpenAI client, streaming or not.
6. **Built-in docs*"},{"id":"p26s15","text":"* — interactive request page at `GET /api/v1/docs`, OpenAPI 3.0 spec at
`GET /api/v1/openapi.json`.
"},{"id":"p26s16","text":"7. **Interactive sessions** — read pending `ask_user_question` batches and answer them over REST, ca"},{"id":"p26s17","text":"ncel
